TNO-100.Title: Invalid configuration
TNO-100.Action: Use the supplied config. Office language must be pt-br.

TNO-101.Title: Administrator access required
TNO-101.Action: Run the application with administrator access.

TNO-102.Title: Unsupported process architecture
TNO-102.Action: Use the x64 application and 64-bit Windows PowerShell.

TNO-103.Title: Another run is active
TNO-103.Action: Wait for the current run to finish.

TNO-104.Title: Working directory unavailable
TNO-104.Action: Check disk space, permissions and redirected/reparse paths.

TNO-200.Title: Inventory incomplete
TNO-200.Action: Unlock or attach the affected profile and retry. Absence cannot be certified.

TNO-201.Title: Restore point unavailable
TNO-201.Action: Check System Protection and organization policy, then retry.

TNO-202.Title: Managed policy conflict
TNO-202.Action: Resolve the conflicting GPO or Intune setting centrally.

TNO-203.Title: Teams removal pending
TNO-203.Action: Close Teams/Outlook, sign into affected profiles, or reboot as indicated, then retry.

TNO-204.Title: Teams data preservation failed
TNO-204.Action: Close Teams and resolve locked, redirected or unreadable data before removal.

TNO-205.Title: Unsupported legacy uninstaller
TNO-205.Action: Use the affected component's supported uninstaller in the correct user account.

TNO-206.Title: User cleanup task needs attention
TNO-206.Action: Sign into the affected account and retry; check Task Scheduler if it still fails.

TNO-207.Title: Reboot required
TNO-207.Action: Restart Windows, then run the application again.

TNO-300.Title: DNS resolution failed
TNO-300.Action: Check network DNS and access to the displayed official download host.

TNO-301.Title: Download connection failed
TNO-301.Action: Check internet, proxy, TLS and firewall access. No credentials are requested.

TNO-303.Title: Publisher signature invalid
TNO-303.Action: Do not run the file. Retry the official download and check certificate/proxy inspection.

TNO-304.Title: Download empty or missing
TNO-304.Action: Retry the transfer; verify the file has nonzero size.

TNO-305.Title: Unapproved download origin
TNO-305.Action: Use the built-in HTTPS Microsoft or Google download source.

TNO-306.Title: ODT discovery fallback used
TNO-306.Action: The official archive fallback is being used. Check the discovery host if it persists.

TNO-307.Title: Unexpected ODT executable
TNO-307.Action: Retry the official ODT package; the executable was not accepted as Office setup.

TNO-400.Title: Installer or uninstaller failed
TNO-400.Action: Use the native exit code shown in Details to troubleshoot the vendor installer.

TNO-401.Title: Existing Office is incompatible
TNO-401.Action: Plan an Office product/architecture migration; automatic removal is disabled.

TNO-402.Title: Office media incomplete
TNO-402.Action: Retry the Office download; the media files did not pass validation.

TNO-403.Title: Application is still open
TNO-403.Action: Save documents, close the indicated app and retry.

TNO-404.Title: Application validation failed
TNO-404.Action: Review the app result and retry the failed download or installation.

TNO-405.Title: Application returned no confirmed result
TNO-405.Action: Retry and review Details; success could not be verified.

TNO-900.Title: Unexpected engine error
TNO-900.Action: Review Details and report the code and message to the project maintainer.

TNO-901.Title: Launcher could not start
TNO-901.Action: Check working-directory access, executable integrity and Windows PowerShell availability.

TNO-902.Title: Script execution blocked
TNO-902.Action: Use organization-approved script signing or policy settings; central policy is not overridden.

TNO-903.Title: Worker returned no result
TNO-903.Action: Review the in-app log and process exit code, then retry.

TNO-904.Title: Result message is invalid
TNO-904.Action: Use a freshly built executable; the in-memory worker result could not be read.
